SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 4748
Date 30 / 5 / 33

Special Branch S.2.
May 29, 1933.

Memorandum on the movements of G.E.Berry-Popoff
alias G.Popoff-Peipin, suspected Soviet agent.

G.E.Berry-Popoff alias G.Popoff-Peipin,
suspected Soviet agent, who left Shanghai for Canton
on March 15, 1933, returned to Shanghai on May 15,
1933 by s.s. "Tsinan".

It is reported that he frequently visits
the dining room at No.48 Rue Mollier owned by one
M. Grabovsky, his former paramour.

His place of abode is at present unknown.

（批：HR）
（签：G. Tcheremshansky.）
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
（签：JBR 29/5）

（批：File）
（签：JHS）

G.E.Berry-Popoff（又名 G.Popoff-Peipin），疑似苏联特工，于1933年3月15日离开上海前往广州，后于1933年5月15日乘“济南”号轮船返回上海。

SECRET
Memorandum on the movements of Gerasim Popoff-Poijin
alias Georgy Efimovitch Berry-Popoff, Suspected
Soviet Agent.

G. Popoff-Peijin alias G.E. Berry-Popoff, suspected
Soviet agent, left Shanghai for Canton via Amoy and Hong-
kong by s.s. "Taiyuan" on March 15, 1933, travelling first
class. It was discovered that Berry-Popoff received an
Emigrant Passport No.9909 from the Bureau of Public Safety
together with one Josif Iosifovitch Malnach on February
15, 1933 and a Foreign Passport No.1778 on February 1, 1933
through the assistance of Z.H.A. Daff & Co., 262 Avenue
Road (Tel.31954). Berry-Popoff produced a letter from this
firm verifying that he is an emigrant employed by the firm
and that he is to proceed to Canton. His profession was
given as radio-telegraphist. Berry-Popoff is a former White
Russian who turned Bolshevik in 1925 at Tientsin and was
attached to the G.P.U. through the medium of Comrade Rivirin,
custodian of the Soviet Consulate in this city. Berry-
Popoff was also recruiting agent for General Galchin's
Detachment in Marshal Feng's Army. Later he was in charge
of the Guard of the Soviet Consulate in Tientsin. During
December 1929 he arrived in Shanghai from Tientsin accom-
panied by John Tishevsky, member of the G.P.U. and chau-
ffeur of Tientsin Soviet Consulate and one Valentin Stro-
ganoff, member of the G.P.U. attached to the Soviet Con-
sulate in Tientsin (███████). They resided in the French
Concession. On March 17, 1930 Berry-Popoff left Shanghai
for an unknown destination. Some time after he returned
to Shanghai and on October 28, 1930 was reported to be the
lover of Mrs. A. Pilavin, wife of M.Pilavin, a suspected
Soviet agent and former employee of Controsojuz in Tientsin.
On November 3, 1931 Berry-Popoff met one S. Mamontoff, sus-
pected Soviet agent and also one M.N. Salnik, Soviet courier
recently arrived from the U.S.S.R. On January 9, 1932 it
was reported that Popoff had a meeting with N.S. Dobrohotoff,

机密
关于 Gerasim Popoff-Poijin（又名 Georgy Efimovitch Berry-Popoff），疑似苏联特工的行踪备忘录。

G. Popoff-Peijin（又名 G.E. Berry-Popoff），疑似苏联特工，于1933年3月15日乘坐“太原”号轮船，经厦门和香港，由上海前往广州，乘坐头等舱。经查，Berry-Popoff 于1933年2月15日与一名 Josif Iosifovitch Malnach 一同从公安局获得第9909号难民护照，并于1933年2月1日通过爱文义路（Avenue Road）262号 Z.H.A. Daff & Co. 公司（电话：31954）的协助获得第1778号外国护照。Berry-Popoff 出示了该公司出具的一封信函，证明他是该公司雇用的难民，并将前往广州。其职业申报为无线电报务员。Berry-Popoff 是一名前白俄，于1925年在天津转变为布尔什维克，并通过本市苏联领事馆保管员 Rivirin 同志的关系隶属于国家政治保卫总局（G.P.U.）。Berry-Popoff 还曾为冯玉祥元帅军队中 Galchin 将军的分队担任招募代理人。后来，他负责天津苏联领事馆的警卫工作。1929年12月期间，他从天津抵达上海，随行人员包括 John Tishevsky（国家政治保卫总局成员，天津苏联领事馆司机）以及 Valentin Stroganoff（国家政治保卫总局成员，隶属天津苏联领事馆）（███████）。他们居住在法租界。1930年3月17日，Berry-Popoff 离开上海前往一个未知的目的地。一段时间后他返回上海，据报在1930年10月28日成为 A. Pilavin 夫人的情人，A. Pilavin 夫人是 M. Pilavin 的妻子，M. Pilavin 是疑似苏联特工，曾任天津 Controsojuz 的雇员。1931年11月3日，Berry-Popoff 会见了 S. Mamontoff（疑似苏联特工）以及 M.N. Salnik（近期从苏联抵达的苏联信使）。1932年1月9日，据报 Popoff 与 N.S. Dobrohotoff 会面，

pages.en:
- 2 - SECRET

employee of the local branch of the Chinese Eastern Railway
formerly employed with the Tientsin branch of the Chinese
Eastern Railway. It was stated during this time that Berry-
Popoff received an invitation to join the Mukden section of
the G.P.U., but he refused to take this position as he was
too well known to the Japanese Police. On January 20, 1932
it was reported that Berry-Popoff visited a Chinese office at
320 Nanking Road, Room 100, probably to meet a Chinese agent.
On February 26, 1932 Popoff met at the wharf one N.Kirienko,
a man reported to be connected with the Tientsin Soviet Con-
sulate, who arrived by s.s. "Fusang" from Tientsin. Kirienko's
sister one Zina Kirienko, was a paramour of Berry-Popoff. She
is a member of the Communist Party and was expelled from Tsing-
tao in 1931 for communist propaganda among American sailors.
During March 1932 it was reported that Berry-Popoff associated
with C.M. Kraslavsky, suspected Soviet agent and M. Pilavin,
suspected Soviet agent. On July 12, 1932 it was reported that
Berry-Popoff would be sent to Mongolia on a special mission
on behalf of the Soviets and that he already received money
from G.P.U. In connection with this he made steps to obtain
the representation some foreign firms, in order to legalise
his position. When in Shanghai he resided at the following
addresses:
"Manchuria Dining Room," Room 14, Avenue Joffre 17.3.31.
48 Rue Mollier, November 1931.
604 Rue Bourgeat, July 15, 1932.
79 Rue Mollier, August 1932.
During March 1933 Berry-Popoff resided at 680 Burkill
Road, house of one Zee Hai Doo (徐梅滇), retired Chief Clerk
of S.M.C. Secretariat.
Berry-Popoff's description is as follows:
Height: 5' 7½"
Dark brown hair.
Brown eyes.
Oval face.
Ordinary nose.

- 2 - 机密

N.S. Dobrohotoff 是中俄铁路本地分支机构的雇员，此前曾受雇于中俄铁路天津分支机构。在此期间，据称 Berry-Popoff 收到加入国家政治保卫总局（G.P.U.）沈阳分部的邀请，但他拒绝了这一职位，因为日本警方对他太过熟悉。1932年1月20日，据报 Berry-Popoff 访问了南京路320号100室的一间华人办公室，可能是为了会见一名华人特工。1932年2月26日，Popoff 在码头会见了一名 N.Kirienko，此人据报与天津苏联领事馆有关联，系从天津乘“福山”号轮船抵达。Kirienko 的妹妹 Zina Kirienko 曾是 Berry-Popoff 的情妇。她是共产党员，1931年因在美国水手中进行共产主义宣传而被青岛驱逐。1932年3月期间，据报 Berry-Popoff 与 C.M. Kraslavsky（疑似苏联特工）和 M. Pilavin（疑似苏联特工）有往来。1932年7月12日，据报 Berry-Popoff 将代表苏联方面执行一项前往蒙古的特殊任务，且他已从国家政治保卫总局（G.P.U.）领取了资金。为此，他采取措施争取一些外国商行的代理权，以使其身份合法化。在上海期间，他居住于以下地址：
“满洲餐厅”，霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）17号14室，1931年3月17日。
莫利爱路（Rue Mollier）48号，1931年11月。
蒲石路（Rue Bourgeat）604号，1932年7月15日。
莫利爱路（Rue Mollier）79号，1932年8月。
1933年3月期间，Berry-Popoff 居住在伯克路（Burkill Road）680号，房主为徐梅滇（Zee Hai Doo），系工部局秘书处退休首席书记员。
Berry-Popoff 的体貌特征如下：
身高：5英尺7½英寸
深褐色头发。
褐色眼睛。
椭圆形脸。
普通鼻型。
